description: This file provides utility functions for reordering items within and across lists, specifically for drag-and-drop operations in a dashboard UI. It includes functions to reorder list elements and to update a map of entities based on drag-and-drop actions, handling special cases for tab-type elements and drop positions.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Reorders a list by moving an element from startIndex to endIndex.

methods.name: reorderItem
methods.description: Reorders items within or across entities in a map based on drag-and-drop source and destination, handling tab-specific logic and drop positions.
